summary: Tested the 4 user-reported bugs. Backend: test_usage_accounting, test_phone_normalization, test_dailyusage_backfill and test_campaign_chain all print ALL PASSED / CHAIN TEST PASSED. New pytest test_iter12_api.py (5/5): a mixed-country campaign stores +919876543210, +971501234567, +15551234567, +447911123456 (no wrong +91 prefix); retry-failed returns 200 with retryCount matching failedCount, and 404 for an unknown campaign; both refresh-daily-usage endpoints return 200. Frontend: Field 1-5 on Send Messages and template-field1-5 in the My Templates dialog are INPUTs. Pressing Enter adds no newline, does not submit and does not close the dialog. A real clipboard paste of 'Hello\nWorld\r\nAgain' becomes 'Hello World Again'. The helper note is visible on both screens. The Campaign Details 'Resend Failed (2)' button shows on a completed all-failed campaign; clicking it opens a confirm, the success toast 'Retrying 2 failed messages' appears and the campaign goes to processing. A scheduled campaign shows scheduled-note, hides the retry button and shows 0.0% with no NaN.

minor.issue: Does not unset completedAt when it moves the campaign back to processing, so Campaign Details shows a stale 'Completed At' while it is running again.

issues: The 'Country of these numbers' select is a native <select> and runs past the right edge of the Recipients card at 1920px (it ends near x=1370 while the card ends near x=1280). Constrain its width or use the shadcn Select.

action_items: Optional: fix the country select overflowing the Recipients card on Send Messages
critical_code_review_comments: retry_failed_messages loads and rewrites the whole campaign.recipients array. This works for small campaigns but is heavy for 100k-recipient campaigns; use an update_many with an array filter or the recipients collection.

The browser's own <input> sanitization strips newlines on programmatic value sets before sanitizeTemplateField runs, so words can join (e.g. 'x\ny' -> 'xy'). A real user paste in Chromium becomes spaces, so users are not affected.
seed_data_creation: Only temporary TEST_ campaigns on qatest, all deleted by id afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use qatest (dummy BizChat creds, sends fail with 'Invalid Token') for retry-failed tests. iter12_seed_ui.py creates one all-failed and one scheduled TEST_ campaign; delete them by id afterwards. The campaign create response returns campaignId.
